records.title: Slovenia: Language, Culture, and Society at a Crossroads
records.header: SLVN 351 Slovenia: Language, Culture, and Society at a Crossroads (5) A&H, DIV
records.text: SLVN 351 Slovenia: Language, Culture, and Society at a Crossroads (5) A&H, DIV Explores impacts of colonial rule, tolerance and intolerance of difference (social, linguistic, ethnic, religious), and social polarization around ideologies in the Slovene lands from the arrival of Slavs in the sixth century CE to the present day. Introduces the language, history, and culture of Slovenia through literature, film, and site visits. Affiliated with the UW Study Abroad Early Fall Start Slovenia program. Offered: A.

records.title: Introductory Slovene Language
records.text: SLVN 401 Introductory Slovene Language (3/5) Introduction to spoken and written Slovene language. First in a two course sequence. Prerequisite: either BCS 403, BULGR 403, CZECH 403, GERMAN 103, ITAL 103, POLISH 403, ROMN 403, RUSS 103, RUSS 150, UKR 403, or status as a heritage speaker of Slovene.

records.text: SLVN 404 Second-Year Slovene Language (3/5) Reinforces and expands foundational knowledge of Slovene language through grammatical topics and exercises, reading of authentic texts, composition, listening, oral presentations, and conversation. Prerequisite: SLVN 402.
